CONCIO XXIIII
Prouerb. II.

l.i: Monile aureum in naribus porci est

main_text.l: 1 Quid dedeceat non solum vxores, sed
etiam virgines & viduas, Salomon hoc loci,
veluti in speculo ostendit. Dicit enim, quem-
admodum alij hoc prouerbium interpretan-
tur: Circulus aureus in naribus suis: mu

page.notes: Printed "Salomon" and "loci" are read as shown. The reference line "Prouerb. II." is printed with Roman numerals and is copied as printed. The word "af-sociat" is a line-end break; the first half is clear, the second is doubtful. Stray dots in the right margin near "animam" and "nobilem" are not text and are not transcribed. The last line breaks mid-word and continues on the next page.
